Campaign Name Generator

Create clean, consistent marketing campaign names — snake_case, kebab-case and UTM-ready variants from your inputs.

FormatGenerated name
Enter brand and campaign to generate names.

Names are sanitized: lowercased, accents stripped, spaces converted per format, special characters removed.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter brand, campaign, channel and an optional date.
  2. Get consistent names in snake_case, kebab-case, spaced and UTM-tag formats.
  3. Copy any variant straight into your ad platform or analytics.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why does campaign naming matter?

Consistent names keep ad platforms, analytics and spreadsheets aligned — "summer_sale" in one place and "Summer-Sale" in another splits your reporting.

What is the UTM variant?

A ready utm_campaign value (lowercase, underscore-separated) you can append to links for Google Analytics tracking.

Which format should I use?

snake_case for UTMs and file names, kebab-case for URLs, spaced Title Case for client-facing reports. This tool gives you all three.
